description: The bar chart illustrates a comparison between two methods — “Ours” and “Standard” — in terms of how their outputs are distributed across three categories: “Context,” “Generated Response,” and “Other,” as evaluated in the paper “Context-Informed Grounding Supervision.” The horizontal axis represents the percentage contribution of each category, while the vertical axis lists the two methods. For the “Ours” method, the stacked bar shows 60.6% attributed to “Context” (dark blue), 31.7% to “Generated Response” (brown), and 7.7% to “Other” (green). In contrast, the “Standard” method’s bar is composed of 23.6% “Context,” 51.1% “Generated Response,” and 25.3% “Other.” The legend at the bottom clarifies the color coding for each category. Visually, “Ours” relies more heavily on “Context” and less on “Other” compared to “Standard,” which allocates a larger share to “Generated Response” and “Other.” The chart uses a segmented horizontal bar format with percentage labels inside each segment, and no gridlines or axis ticks are visible beyond the category labels on the y-axis.
